# Vendored third-party assets

Third-party browser assets served from this application's own origin instead of a public CDN.

Corporate and bank networks frequently block public CDNs. When the rasterizer failed to load, the
quote-image button fell back to server-side Browser Rendering — the exact metered, concurrency
limited path that ADR 0017 removed from the hot path. Self-hosting closes that fallback risk.

## `html2canvas-1.4.1.min.js`

- Upstream: `html2canvas` 1.4.1 by Niklas von Hertzen — <https://html2canvas.hertzen.com>
- License: MIT (the license header is preserved verbatim in the file; do not strip it)
- Size: 198,689 bytes
- SHA-256: `e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb`

Provenance check performed before vendoring: the file was fetched independently from
`cdn.jsdelivr.net` and `unpkg.com` and both copies were byte-identical, matching the SHA-256 above.
The bundle contains no third-party network requests — the only URLs present are the SVG namespace
identifier and the author's homepage inside the license comment.

Used by `index.html` for both runtime modes: the static GitHub-Pages quote-sheet export
(`app.js`) and the Cloudflare application's client-side quote-card rasterization
(`backend-client.js`, ADR 0017).

### Updating

Do not edit this file. To change versions, fetch the new release from at least two independent
mirrors, confirm the copies are byte-identical, record the new size and SHA-256 here, and verify
both image paths still produce a correct PNG. Treat it as a production dependency change requiring
explicit approval.
